text:
rachel_csm: Heads-up  GreenRiver Labs tokens/day dropped ~86% over 8 days. Renewal in 12 days. Their champion left and procurement asked for a competitor bakeoff. Need fast triage and a retention playbook.

alerts-bot: Alert: customer=GreenRiverLabs, metric=tokens_8d, change=-86%, seats=6->2, error_rate=0.6%->4.2%, recent_deploy=2026-03-11. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/customers/greenriver/health

marcus_sales: I spoke with procurement  they said "responses timing out" and DynaAI offered a 2-week pilot. I'll lead commercial outreach. Do we have a compact cost/latency sheet to send?

anya_eng: Quick checks I'll run: per-key activity, error histogram, instance OOMs around 3/16-3/18, and model routing log. If anyone can get a failing req id that helps.

sam_ops: Billing shows two seats removed by an automated job on 3/15, likely SSO deprovision. Also saw their top key go inactive 3/16.

alerts-bot: Summary (7d): errors=502(58%), 429(22%), 401(20%). Top_key last active 2026-03-16. Noticeable 502 cluster 2026-03-17 01:00-03:00 UTC.

rachel_csm: Scheduling a 15-min call with their interim PM in 20m to get failing ids and confirm key rotation or preview endpoint use.

marcus_sales: Draft counter: 10-day dedicated microburst at 3x baseline + 1-hr tech pairing, no immediate contract needed. Need finance nod for credits > $3k. Tagging @finance.

anya_eng: On the call now  PM gave two ids: req_20260317_a1 and req_20260318_b2. Triage: a1 -> 502 due to router OOM from large payloads; b2 -> 401 old key. Root cause = batch size spike + partial key rotation + accidental route to preview endpoint.

sam_ops: Immediate mitigations: restored seats, whitelisted PM IP for pairing, temporarily bumped per-key burst x3 for confirmed key, and applied a server-side throttle for payloads >5k with clear error messaging.

marcus_sales: Sent written offer: 10-day microburst (3x), 1-hr pairing, and a post-trial perf report. Asked for acceptance within 24h.

rachel_csm: Added renewal-risk tag and playbook with owners and due dates. Scheduling 3-day check-in.

alerts-bot: Follow-up 6h later: tokens/day recovered to 76% baseline after quota bump and key reconciliation; error rate down to 1.0%. Recommend 48h monitor and QBR prep.

marcus_sales: Procurement paused DynaAI trial pending our microburst. If telemetry stays green, churn risk should be mitigated. Will update when customer signs confirmation. :thumbsup:
